name: Tirzepatide
reviewed_by: William Gregory M. Rivero, MD, FPCP, DPSN
drafted_by: AI-assisted draft (Claude) for review by Dr. W. Rivero

key_interactions.action: Consider reducing the insulin or sulfonylurea dose when starting tirzepatide.
Switch to a non-oral method or add a barrier method for 4 weeks after starting and after each dose increase.

key_interactions.effect: Delayed gastric emptying may change absorption (label).
key_interactions.action: Monitor, for example INR with warfarin.
